_about: Default alert thresholds for the health-twin notification engine. Three layers per signal: (1) absolute guideline limits, (2) personal-baseline anomaly (robust z = (x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD) over the user's own history in the same context), (3) persistence + cooldown so one noisy minute never notifies. Values marked 'from_data' come from the thesis recordings (Hemel days 1-8, Spriha days 1-4, Dhaka, Oct 2026). Every threshold is a starting point to tune with the in-app 'useful / not useful' feedback.

baseline_learning.note: Until min_days is reached only absolute (layer 1) alerts fire. Baselines are kept per context (sleep, sitting, walking, vehicle, per place class).

notification_policy.quiet_hours: while asleep (band sleep stage) or 23:00-07:00 local; only 'urgent' passes
notification_policy.note: The user response log (useful / not useful / wrong) is evaluation data for the thesis and the basis for threshold tuning.

high_at_rest.condition: band steps < 10/min and context not walking/vehicle
high_at_rest.source: same default as common smartwatch high-HR notifications (120 bpm, 10 min inactive)

sleeping_hr_elevated.baseline: median of the last 7 nights' mean sleeping HR
sleeping_hr_elevated.note: +5 bpm is about 3 SD of night-to-night variation for both participants

cadence_lock_guard.note: while walking the optical band can report step rate instead of pulse; drop those minutes before any HR rule (seen on 22/30 min of one Hemel walk)

exclude: first and last 5 strides of a walk
minutes where the sensor health check flags a pressure sensor

from_data.Spriha: left larger on all 3 days: a personal baseline, not an alert

step_phase_pct.note: left heel strike as % of the right cycle; only valid when both insoles share a synced clock (invalid on every Spriha day)

gait_asymmetry.rule: alert when |SI - personal_median| > max(abs_floor, k * MAD) in 2 consecutive windows
gait_asymmetry.severity: nudge (first), warning if it persists across 3 walks in a day
gait_asymmetry.pressure_based_measures: disabled for a foot whose FSRs were replaced or flagged; IMU-based stance/swing/push-off are the primary measures
gait_asymmetry.body_size_normalisation: compare stride time as stride_s / sqrt(L / 9.81), L = 0.53 * height_m (removes most of the difference between people)

possible_slip.extra: forefoot-first contact (no heel load at impact)
possible_slip.action: ask 'Did you slip or stumble?' (Yes / No) and log the answer
possible_slip.note: one real slip only and a thin margin: treat as a candidate detector and use the confirmations as labels

pm25.status_display: EPA AQI category of the rolling 1-h mean (2024 breakpoints, ug/m3): good <=9.0, moderate <=35.4, unhealthy for sensitive groups <=55.4, unhealthy <=125.4, very unhealthy <=225.4, hazardous >225.4

spike_alert.message: very high particle level - move away or ventilate

daily_report_only.note: Dhaka indoor/outdoor medians were 50-80, so a 15 threshold would notify all day: show it in the report, never as a push

co2_ppm.precondition: fresh-air calibration done (the sensor read below outdoor ~420 ppm)

heat.precondition: node uptime > 30 min AND per-node calibration offset applied (cold start reads up to 12 C high within 30 min; fixed -5 C offset is not enough)

daily_target_l_from_drinks.source: about 80 % of the EFSA adequate total water intake (2.5 / 2.0 L incl. food)
daily_target_l_from_drinks.heat_adjustment_when: daily max heat index >= 32 C (heuristic, label it as such)

hydration.do_not_claim: water before walking lowers heart rate - not supported (partial rho 0.04 after time of day)

sitting_too_long.message: stand up and move for 2-3 minutes

posture.calibration: per-user 'sit upright' calibration at first use; for Hemel the cushion reported deliberate upright sitting as LEAN_FORWARD

from_data.Spriha: band records only part of the night - not comparable

data_quality.severity: info (shown in the app status bar; push only during an active session)
